CT-411 |homeworld=[[Kamino]]{{SWE|characters|clonecommanderponds|Clone Commander Ponds}} |birth= |death=[[21 BBY]], ''[[Slave I]]''''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," including the [[death]] of Ponds onboard ''[[Slave I]]'' to [[21 BBY]]. |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Cloning|clone]]}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Databank|clone-commander-ponds|Clone Commander Ponds}} |pronouns=He/him |donor=[[Jango Fett]] |height=1.83 [[meter]]s {{C|6 [[Foot|ft]]}}''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=Brown{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}} |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|76|Helmets}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|General, the enemy fire is penetrating our shields!|Ponds, to Mace Windu|}} '''Ponds''', designated '''CT-411''', was a [[clone trooper officer]] who held the [[military rank]] of [[Clone Commander]]. Ponds was [[Cloning|bred]] from the [[DNA|genetic]] [[Clone template|template]] of the [[human]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], he served under the command of [[Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. On [[Geonosis]], [[Commander]] Ponds arranged for five special [[commando]] units to follow Windu's orders during the [[First Battle of Geonosis|first battle]] of the war. Specializing in military reconnaissance, Ponds was the [[commander]] of [[Lightning Squadron]], a [[Squadron|unit]] of [[Advanced Recon Force trooper|Advanced Recon Force Scout Troopers]] in the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]]. As the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] spread across [[the galaxy]], Ponds accompanied Windu on a [[Republic Military]] [[Battle of Ryloth|campaign]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] of [[Ryloth]] in order to liberate the [[Twi'lek]] [[homeworld]]. There he fought alongside Windu with the support of Lightning Squadron, including [[trooper]]s [[Razor]] and [[Stak]]. After joining forces with the [[Twi'lek Resistance]], Ponds and Windu led a direct assault on the [[capital]] [[Lessu City]], [[Prisoner|captured]] [[Emir]] [[Wat Tambor]] and ultimately lifted the Separatist occupation of Ryloth. In addition to the campaign on Ryloth, Ponds participated in the [[Battle of Malastare]] where he assisted Windu in the capture of a [[Zillo Beast]]. He was later stationed on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Endurance]]'' at a [[time]] when the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] [[Sabotage of the Endurance|plotted]] to [[assassin]]ate Windu. After the Republic [[warship]] crashed on the surface of [[Vanqor]]—having been sabotaged by Fett—Ponds was taken [[prisoner]] by Fett's [[mercenary]] allies along with [[Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian|Kilian]] and a [[clone navigation officer]]. He was [[Death|executed]] shortly afterward by [[Aurra Sing]] in an attempt to lure Windu into a trap. Despite the [[commander]]'s death, Fett ultimately failed in his attempts to kill Windu and was sent to [[prison]] after the [[Jedi]] [[Second mission to Florrum|captured]] him on [[Florrum]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== {{Quote|Visit I will the cloners on Kamino, and see this army they have created for the Republic.|Yoda, to Mace Windu|{{Film|II}}}} [[File:Ponds_AotC.png|thumb|left|250px|Ponds served as a Clone Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic.]] CT-411, who in time adopted the name Ponds, was a [[Clone Commander]] who belonged to an [[army]] of [[Kamino]]-based [[clone trooper]]s—[[Cloning|grown]] from the [[DNA|genetic]] material of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]]—created to serve the [[Galactic Republic]].{{Databank|clone-troopers|Clone Troopers}} By modifying Fett's genetic structure, the [[Kaminoan]]s accelerated the clones' aging process so that they would reach maturity within a [[Standard decade|decade]] of their inception. Around the same [[time]], the Republic was on the verge of civil war due to a growing [[Separatist Crisis|secessionist movement]] that ultimately led to the creation of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As a result, Ponds and his brethren were pressed into service as the backbone of the newly-formed [[Grand Army of the Republic]] in [[22 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' Unlike many of the other [[Cloning|Clone]] [[Commander]]s, Ponds did not receive [[ARC program|ARC training]], though as a part of the first batch of [[clone trooper officer]]s, Ponds was trained by Jango Fett himself, as well as other senior instructors. By the end of his training, Ponds was specialized in military reconnaissance, but notably was not briefed on how to interact with [[Jedi high command]]''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' and was also not selected to be part of the program that trained clone [[officer]]s on how to work as liaisons between [[Jedi General]]s and clone [[trooper]]s. On the onset, Ponds was trained with the [[DC-15A blaster rifle]]. ===First Battle of Geonosis=== {{Quote|Sir. I have five special commando units awaiting your orders, sir.|Ponds, to Mace Windu|}} [[File:Jedi_Generals_Geonosis.png|thumb|right|250px|Ponds reported to Jedi Master Mace Windu during the First Battle of Geonosis.]] Ponds was one of many clone troopers of the two [[Sector Army|battle armies]][[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] who accompanied [[Yoda]], the [[Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order]], to the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] where they fought the Confederacy's [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]], igniting the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] and the [[galaxy]]-wide conflict known as the [[Clone Wars]]. During the battle, he provided [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] with five special [[commando]] units. From that point, Ponds served with [[General]] Windu as his preferred liaison and second-in-command. Although his training lacked instructions on how to interact with the [[Jedi]] like the [[adjutant]]s [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]] introduced to Yoda, Ponds was able to gain the trust of Windu. Ponds found himself in a role interacting with high command despite not being briefed on it, and Windu kept the trooper by his side throughout the battle. At one point in the battle on Geonosis, Commander Ponds was on the command bridge of a [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery|SPHA-T walker]], directing efforts with a [[Clone Captain]] on the [[walker]]'s bridge after Yoda ordered the artillery walkers to focus their attack on the nearest Separatist [[core ship]], successfully bringing it crashing towards the surface. Following the ship's crash and ensuing sand storm, Ponds and the other clone troopers were glad that their helmets had a respiration filter. Following the Republic victory on Geonosis, Ponds remained at Windu's side as the Clone Wars spread across [[the galaxy]], and when Windu took command of the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]], Ponds went with him. A specialist in military reconnaissance, he would also serve as the [[commanding officer]] of [[Lightning Squadron]], a ground [[squadron]] of [[Advanced Recon Force trooper|Advanced Recon Force Scout Troopers]]{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}} within the [[corps]]. ===Battle of Ryloth=== {{Quote|Droids have begun a firebombing campaign. Several villages in our sector have been destroyed, sir.|Ponds, to Mace Windu|audio=FireBombingCampaign-LoR.flac|}} [[File:Ponds_watches_Ryloth_village_destruction.png|thumb|left|250px|Ponds witnessed the decimation of a Twi'lek village by Separatist air forces during the Battle of Ryloth.]] Early in the war, [[Ryloth]]—the [[Homeworld|home]] [[planet]] of the [[Twi'lek]] [[species]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]—fell to a [[Battle of Ryloth|Separatist invasion]] led by [[Emir]] [[Wat Tambor]], [[foreman]] of the [[Techno Union]] and a member of the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]]. Though the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|Confederacy navy]] formed a [[blockade]] around the planet in preparation for a Republic attack, [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] successfully created a breach in the enemy's defense perimeter,{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}} allowing for Ponds and [[General]] Windu to bring their ground forces to Ryloth. The ground invasion was stalled by several [[J-1 proton cannon]]s; located in the [[city]] of [[Nabat]], the [[cannon]]s opened fire on the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], destroying one of them just as Ponds informed Windu that the [[proton bomb]]s had penetrated the [[transport]]s' [[deflector shield]]s. After the cannons were destroyed by General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[212th Attack Battalion]], Windu and Ponds brought the ground forces to the surface and proceeded to march on the [[capital]] [[Lessu City]]. [[File:Triumphant_fighters_on_Ryloth.png|thumb|right|250px|Following the Separatists' defeat, Ponds attended a victory parade in Lessu along with Mace Windu, Orn Free Ta, and Cham Syndulla.]] En route to the capital, the Republic army was ambushed by a group of [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|Armored Assault Tanks]]. At Windu's direction, Ponds ordered Lightning Squadron to engage the Separatists and although they succeeded in destroying the [[tank]]s, the casualties they sustained necessitated the need for reinforcements. To that end, Windu sought out [[Cham Syndulla]] to form an alliance with the [[Twi'lek Resistance]] while Ponds remained with the main force. After discovering a local village populated by women and children, Ponds intended to provide them with some of the army's rations, only to witness the village's destruction by a group of Separatist [[Hyena-class Droid Fighter/Bomber|''Hyena''-class Droid Bombers]]. Upon learning of the attack from the commander's report, Syndulla committed his resistance fighters to the Republic's imminent assault on Lessu. The battle for Lessu commenced with Windu leading the initial attack on the city, leaving Ponds and Syndulla to direct their combined forces into Lessu while the Jedi Master proceeded to [[Prisoner|capture]] Wat Tambor. Having succeeded in driving the remaining Separatists away from Ryloth, Ponds—along with Windu, Syndulla, and [[Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa]]—attended a victory parade in Lessu where the Twi'leks celebrated their renewed liberty. ===Battle of Malastare=== {{Quote|Sir, there's nothing around here but rocks and debris.''"
"''I have a bad feeling about this.|Ponds and Mace Windu, just prior to discovering the Zillo Beast|{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}}} [[File:Hello_beastie.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Following the Battle of Malastare, Ponds and Windu discovered the Zillo Beast.]] In [[21 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Ponds accompanied Windu to [[Malastare]], a [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] planet rich in natural [[fuel]] reserves. Working in conjunction with the native [[Dug]] population, as well as Anakin Skywalker and [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] of the [[501st Legion]], Ponds' clone troopers [[Battle of Malastare|defended]] Malastare against an army of Separatist battle [[droid]]s. During the battle, the Republic field-tested an experimental [[superweapon]] called the [[electro-proton bomb]], which could release an [[electromagnetic pulse]] disabling the Separatists' droids while causing no harm to the clones. However, the [[bomb]] also had an adverse effect on the environment of Malastare, causing parts of the surface to break and form a large sinkhole in the center of the battlefield. Following the battle, Ponds formed a search party with Windu and clone troopers [[Trapper (clone trooper)|Trapper]] and [[Hawkeye]] and traveled into the pit to rescue survivors. In the course of their search, they encountered the [[Zillo Beast]], a large creature that had been awoken from its slumber by the detonation of the bomb. Ponds, Trapper, and Hawkeye opened fire, but the creature's skin proved impervious to [[blaster]]s and even [[lightsaber]]s. After Ponds, Windu, and Trapper escaped from the sinkhole, the Republic succeeded in capturing the Zillo Beast by using several [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank|RX-200 ''Falchion''-class assault tanks]] to incapacitate it. ===Service aboard the ''Endurance''=== {{Quote|I'm staying with the Admiral. You'd better evacuate.|Ponds, ordering a clone trooper to evacuate the ''Endurance''|{{TCW|Death Trap}}}} [[File:KilianResolute.png|thumb|right|250px|Commander Ponds and Admiral Kilian remained aboard the ''Endurance'' while the crew was evacuated.]] Later in the Clone Wars, Ponds joined Windu and Skywalker aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Endurance]]'', commanded by [[Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian|Kilian]] of the [[Republic Navy]]. Unknown to Ponds and the crew, however, [[Boba Fett]]—an unaltered clone of Jango Fett—infiltrated the Republic [[flagship]] by posing as a member of the [[Clone Youth Brigade]]. After failing to [[assassin]]ate Windu, who [[Death|killed]] Jango in single combat on Geonosis, Boba [[Sabotage of the Endurance|sabotaged]] the ''Endurance'' in order to escape the [[Starship|vessel]]. Unable to prevent the [[Star Destroyer]] from crashing on [[Vanqor]], the crew was evacuated in the [[escape pod]]s, although Ponds elected to stay behind as Kilian refused to leave the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. ===Capture and death=== {{Quote|What's your name? Name!''"
"''CT-411.|Aurra Sing and Ponds, moments before the latter's execution|{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}}} [[File:Ponds_ejected.png|thumb|left|250px|After Ponds' execution, his corpse was ejected into the vacuum of space.]] Ponds survived the crash of the ''Endurance'' on Vanqor, but was soon captured along with Kilian and a [[clone navigation officer]] by the [[bounty hunter]]s Boba Fett, [[Aurra Sing]], [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]], and [[Castas]]. By the time Windu and Skywalker arrived at the crash site to [[Mission to Vanqor|search for survivors]], the [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] had taken their [[prisoner]]s to ''[[Slave I]]''. While Windu and Skywalker conducted search and rescue, Windu commented that Ponds had been on the bridge, and when a [[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigate]] was ready to depart with the survivors, Windu commented that they must assume Ponds and the rest of the officers were lost.{{TCW|R2 Come Home}} While traveling through [[Realspace|space]], Sing executed Ponds, whose death Windu and Skywalker witnessed through a [[Hologram|holographic]] transmission that was sent to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]]. Skywalker sadly commented on the footage, while Windu only watched in grim silence. After Ponds' death, his body was jettisoned into space as the bounty hunters continued on their way to [[Florrum]], where they were confronted by [[Plo Koon]] and Ahsoka Tano. Ultimately, the two Jedi successfully rescued the remaining hostages and captured Fett, who was sent to [[prison]] as punishment for his actions aboard the ''Endurance'' as well as the taking of hostages.{{Databank|boba-fett-biography-gallery|Boba Fett Biography Gallery}} The body of Ponds was considered lost after it was jettisoned, and despite the success of capturing the culprits, there was nothing that could be done about Commander Ponds, who was considered a hero of the Republic. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|The enemy's already pulled out, sir. Friendlies are all that's left, mostly women and children.''"
"''See if we can spare some rations. They'll be hungry.|A clone trooper and Ponds|audio=SpareSomeRations-LoR.flac|}} [[File:Ponds_inside_AT-TE.png|thumb|right|300px|On Ryloth, Ponds was willing to provide civilians with assistance in order to ease their hardships.]] A clone of Jango Fett, Ponds was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who stood at 1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|feet]]) tall. He had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s and a shaved head. Like clone troopers in general, Commander Ponds was an obedient [[soldier]] who followed orders. His Jedi General, Mace Windu of the [[Jedi High Council]], trusted Ponds since the beginning of the Clone Wars. He was a veteran commander, serving in many battles including Geonosis, Ryloth and Malastare. During the campaign of Ryloth, Ponds tried to provide a local settlement—populated mostly by women and children—with spare rations from his own [[regiment]] so that the people would not starve, only to witness the village's bombardment by Separatist [[bomber]]s. When the ''Endurance'' was sabotaged and set to crash on Vanqor's surface, Commander Ponds felt that it was his duty to remain with Admiral Kilian and the bridge officers. By the time of his death, Ponds was considered a hero of the Republic. Ponds was better known by his name than his number.{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/databank-download-ct-411-commander-ponds-arf-clone-troopers-preview|text=Databank Download: CT-411 Commander Ponds & ARF Clone Troopers Preview|date=2023-07-18}} When faced with death at the hands of Aurra Sing, Ponds displayed defiance towards the bounty hunter, answering only with his number when she demanded his name. Although she deemed his last act of rebellion as pathetic, he left behind a positive legacy within the Republic, with Anakin Skywalker sadly noting him by name after watching the execution. ==Skills and abilities== Although not being a part of several advanced training programs such as the ARC program or the program to train clone troopers to serve as liaisons with the Jedi, Ponds was highly skilled in leadership, becoming the second-in-command after General Mace Windu. Ponds was also highly skilled in reconnaissance, and as an officer within the 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps, leading the Lightning Squadron on Ryloth. He also led [[Tank|armored]] vehicles in combat. He also was trained in combat abilities and military tactics. ==Equipment== [[File:CmdrPonds1-SWBC42.png|thumb|right|250px|Ponds was equipped with Phase I clone trooper armor and dual DC-17 blaster pistols.]] At the start of his service in the Grand Army of the Republic, Ponds wore the standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor]] with the yellow markings of a clone commander. Following the Battle of Geonosis, the Jedi encouraged the clones to develop their sense of individuality.{{Databank|clone-trooper-armor|Clone Trooper Armor}} Ponds therefore customized his [[Clone trooper armor|armor]] to designate his unit affiliation, which included the phrase "''some guys have all the luck''" stenciled in [[Aurebesh]] on the back of his [[Armor|helmet]]. He also wore a [[Republic military uniforms|Republic officer uniform]] during the early stages of the Battle of Ryloth. Ponds' [[helmet]], like all the others, was equipped with a [[comlink]] system which kept Ponds in communication with his Jedi commanders and fellow clone troopers. In addition to the standard DC-15A [[blaster rifle]], which Ponds used on Ryloth, he wielded two [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|DC-17 blaster pistols]] which he adopted when many other commanders did as well. ==Behind the scenes== Ponds first appeared in the [[2008]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who provided the voices of all clone troopers throughout the series' run. However, the character was retconned to be the Clone Commander who speaks with Windu during the Battle of Geonosis in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] of the [[prequel trilogy]]. Like every clone trooper in the film, he was voiced by actor [[Temuera Morrison]] and portrayed entirely through computer-generated imagery. Therefore, Ponds retroactively made his first appearance in 2002. In "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," Ponds states that his clone designation number is CT-411. In Ponds' encyclopedia entry on Star Wars.com, however, his designation is said to be CC-6454, and this number was also used in ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''. ==Appearances==
